verdict.rationale: Letta's data model is inherently open-format: agent memory is stored as Markdown files in a memory repository, shared memory is backed by real Git repositories, and self-hosting lets you run agents entirely on infrastructure you control with local state (letta-docs-11, letta-docs-21, letta-docs-30, letta-probe-rt-2). This gives strong portability/no-lock-in for local/self-hosted use, but there is no explicit documented 'export my cloud data and leave' feature or data-export tool for chat.letta.com/cloud-backed agents. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-export/download feature for cloud-hosted agent data, and independent confirmation that exported Markdown/Git data can be re-imported elsewhere without vendor tooling.
